annotation.authors_or_issuer: Italian Government (Ministry of Education, University and Research; Ministry of Economic Development; Minister for Technological Innovation and Digital Transition)
annotation.venue: Italian Ministry of University and Research (mur.gov.it)
annotation.summary_en: Italy's national Strategic Programme on AI for 2022-2024 sets six objectives, eleven priority sectors and 24 policy initiatives across talent, research and applications. It stresses EU-anchored, trustworthy AI and adoption in public administration and industry. It creates a permanent AI steering group within the Interministerial Committee for Digital Transition. Embodied AI appears only in passing.
key_provisions_or_claims: Six objectives, eleven priority sectors and three intervention areas: talent, research, applications
24 policy initiatives, including PhD programmes, AI research chairs and public-private research calls
Defines a national governance system for certifying higher-risk AI products (D.4)
Promotes regulatory experimentation through Sperimentazione Italia, with temporary exemptions from existing rules
Creates a permanent AI steering group in the Digital Transition Interministerial Committee to monitor implementation
